test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

I try to retrieve the note from my pocket while ______ the tray steady on my palm.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Holding'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase **"while holding"** indicates that the subject (the speaker) is trying to retrieve the note from their pocket while simultaneously keeping the tray steady on their palm.
 
• So,** option 3) "holding"** is the correct answer as it accurately describes the physical action required in the sentence.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'I try to retrieve the note from my pocket while **holding** the tray steady on my palm'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meanings** of the other given options:
 
• **Noting:** "noting" refers to the act of observing or taking note of something, but it does not fit the context of the sentence.(ध्यान देना)
 
• **Scolding:** "scolding" means reprimanding or criticizing someone in a harsh or angry manner.(डांटना)
 
• **Plotting:** "plotting" refers to planning or scheming. (षड्यंत्र रचना)
